jobs.description:
Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

The Role

We are looking for an engineer passionate about building the next generation of high-scale audio processing infrastructure for communication centers that form a vital part of our critical infrastructure, including emergency dispatch centers and hospitals. You will be responsible for integrating AI capabilities into environments dominated by network protocols like SIP and SIPREC, ensuring robust and scalable performance at the heart of life-critical operations.

What you'll be doing:

• 
Architect and maintain systems processing over 100,000 calls per day.

• 
Develop foundational infrastructure using network protocols such as SIP and SIPREC.

• 
Integrate AI capabilities into low-latency, high-throughput audio processing pipelines.

• 
Collaborate with the Platform Engineering team with a commitment to engineering excellence to ensure system reliability and scalability.

• 
Hands-on development of an innovative solution where design choices matter

• 
Work with colleagues in design and code reviews

• 
Contribute to a strong culture of development at Corti through mentorship of developers of all levels

What you bring:

• 
Master of Golang

• 
Deep understanding of network protocols, specifically SIP and SIPREC

• 
Proven track record of building and scaling foundational infrastructure

• 
Experience in ideating and implementing features with high complexity

• 
Hands-on experience with cloud computing architecture and development

• 
Experience running, monitoring, and operating REST, WebSockets, Kafka or an event-driven architecture

• 
Experience with containers and orchestration tools

• 
A passion for writing clean and efficient code

• 
Experience with WebSocket, gRPC and CockroachDB is a significant plus.

• 
Experience with real-time audio processing and WebRTC is a significant plus.

• 
Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, including all-remote communication

Life at Corti

• 
You will be reporting to the Director of Platform Engineering.

• 
The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

• 
Hybrid working environment in Copenhagen.

• 
Equipment provided by Corti

Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Hit that 'Apply' button, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.

🤝 Bringing in top talent from all backgrounds is crucial in our pursuit to improve the world of healthcare. We encourage applications from all people and do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, and/or disability status.

At Corti, experience comes in many forms, and we’re passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we’re looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you’ll consider applying!

Are you passionate about finding new drug opportunities? Do you love understanding disease biology to guide the best possible drug design? Are you a seasoned professional and looking for the next step?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Director, Product Innovation.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and expanded portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Ascendis Pharma is expanding our Product Innovation department and searching for an Associate Director to help drive the future pipeline and the company’s growth towards 2030 and beyond.

The Product Innovation department’s primary objective is to conduct analysis and propose new potential products for the company pipeline. With Patients in mind, new lead finding is based on thorough analysis which typically includes disease biology, unmet medical need, market assessment, competitive intelligence, FTO and assessment of path to FiH. With “Science” as a fundamental corporate value, analysis is rooted in a deep biological understanding of the disease, available (pre)clinical data, Mode of Action across modalities/lines of treatment and the impact a given molecular design/TPP will achieve. As a critical function to building Ascendis Pharma’s future, the Product Innovation department has high exposure to executive management and works closely with adjacent functions.

The Associate Director Product Innovation will play a critical role in Ascendis' success in Endocrinology Rare Disease as well as novel therapeutic areas. She/He will be the driving force behind providing high-quality analysis and pitch decks which enable value-oriented and informed decision-making by the EMT. By gathering, analyzing, and transforming data into concise, actionable ideas, you will play an important role in shaping the future pipeline.

You will be joining the Product Innovation team and report directly to Steffen Nyegaard, Director, Product Innovation who is based in Hellerup_. You will also be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Identification of new drug candidates and indications of interest

• In-depth analysis of diseases, treatment guidelines, competitive environment, how different MoA will affect the disease pathology, market and patents into final reports

• Act as strategic thought partner across different functions and teams, e.g. supporting early research projects or conducting deep-dive analytics to support key business decisions

• Staying current in relevant fields and tracking news widely (e.g., scientific literature, analyst reports, regulatory documents) and share findings with key stakeholders

• Establish processes, structures, and templates when necessary to support Ascendis' growth

Qualifications and Skills:

You have a PhD in life sciences and preferably post doctorial experience from a leading university or group. The ideal candidate has significant experience in lead finding and drug development and knows how to leverage their knowledge into actionable outcomes. The candidate possesses a strong biological profile, which enables them to quickly learn and understand novel biological systems, identify critical issues and unmet needs, and generate analyses with high level take-home and next-step recommendations.

Ideally**, you have:**

• 5 years of industry experience from Pharma or biotech within research or BD

• A strong biological profile with documented track record from the apex of the field

• Significant work experience with the different functions within the pharma value chain

• Experience in the use of public and private databases (e.g. Patsnap, Cortellis, Globaldata, Evaluate or similar)

• The ability to synthesize complex information to both high scientific and layman levels and present it in a clear, actionable manner

• English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

You are passionate about science, love learning and have a deep understanding of disease biology

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to demonstrate strong stakeholder management and communication skills, high personal and scientific integrity and the ability to navigate complex environments.

Travel: 20-30days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Steffen Nyegaard, Director Product Innovation, sny@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

About the job

Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

Some of the core capabilities include:

• Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

What you'll do

As an Android Engineer, you'll contribute far beyond implementation. You'll help shape technical direction while remaining deeply involved in building products. You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

• Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• Build and maintain features in the Android POS platform in Kotlin/Compose that connects to printers, payment terminals and utilizes real–time communication via AWS MQTT.

• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

Who you are

We're looking for experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and helping others succeed.

You likely bring:

• 2-5 years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience designing and operating distributed systems

• Comfortable working with modern software engineering practices, including testing and version control

• Curious, pragmatic, and eager to learn new technologies

• Strong communication skills and a willingness to take ownership of your work

• A collaborative mindset and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively

• A self-starter that gets your jobs done independently or actively seeks help if needed

• Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

You'll be working with the following technologies; we don't expect experience with every technology listed; we're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

• Kotlin, Android, Java

• Jetpack Compose, MVVM

• Dagger Hilt, Room, DataStore

• Retrofit, AWS MQTT

• JUnit, Espresso, Robolectric

• CI/CD with GitHub Actions

• Targeting hardware such as scanners, printers & payment terminals

Why Flatpay?

As part of our team, you'll join 2,000+ passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments.

You'll help build a strategic new business area from the ground up, working on products that directly connect merchants and consumers while shaping the future of online payments at Flatpay.

We offer an inclusive environment where engineers are trusted with ownership and encouraged to make an impact.

Our engineering teams work together from our Copenhagen office. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture.

We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more.

If you're ready to help build and scale the future of payments, we'd love to hear from you.

About us

Welcome to Flatpay!

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we are dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

Today, we are one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics - and Denmark's fastest unicorn!

Flatpay is more than just work. We believe in fostering a vibrant and fun work culture where our ambitious colleagues can thrive. As part of our team, you will be one of +2.000 passionate colleagues dedicated to making a difference in the world of payments.

What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs.

Let's shape the future of merchants together!

HELP BUILD DENMARK'S FUTURE HYDROGEN INFRASTRUCTURE

Ballerup / Egtved

Denmark is undergoing a historic transformation of its energy system. As the owner and operator of Denmark's electricity and gas transmission infrastructure, Energinet plays a pivotal role in developing the solutions that will support the country's transition to a greener energy future.

One of Energinet's most ambitious projects is the establishment of the Danish Hydrogen Backbone – Denmark's future national hydrogen transmission infrastructure, designed to connect the production, consumption and export of green hydrogen. The project will play a vital role in both Denmark's and Europe's green transition and represents one of the country's most complex energy infrastructure projects today.

We are now looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to play a key role in this landmark project. Beyond contributing to the successful delivery of the Danish Hydrogen Backbone, we are looking for someone who is motivated by the opportunity to become a long-term part of Energinet and help shape Denmark's critical energy infrastructure for years to come.

Lead electrical engineering in a landmark energy infrastructure project

As part of the Engineering department in Gas Transmission, you will serve as the Electrical Engineering Discipline Lead for the Project Danish Hydrogen Backbone project.

You will play a key role in the development of the electrical systems for the project's hydrogen stations, where hydrogen will be received, regulated and transported safely. Acting as a key technical authority, you will contribute throughout the entire project lifecycle, from detailed design and technical clarification to construction, commissioning and handover to operations.

You will join a multidisciplinary project environment, working closely with specialists in Instrumentation, SCADA, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technical Safety and Asset Management, as well as Energinet's international EPCM partner and other external consultants.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the technical solutions in a project where quality, safety and long-term reliability are critical to success.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
acting as the Electrical Engineering Discipline Lead throughout the design, construction and commissioning phases

• 
reviewing and approving technical solutions, drawings and engineering documentation

• 
defining technical requirements and documentation standards

• 
ensuring robust electrical solutions, including power supply systems, UPS, control panels, EMC, cable segregation, earthing and lightning protection

• 
contributing to transient studies, emergency shutdown (ESD) strategies, Cause & Effect philosophies and system integrity

• 
participating in FAT, SAT, commissioning and site supervision activities

• 
ensuring compliance with applicable legislation, industry standards and ATEX requirements

You bring experience from large-scale and technically complex process or energy facilities

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer who has a proven track record of working on large-scale technical infrastructure projects and thrives in multidisciplinary environments where engineering disciplines, regulatory requirements and multiple stakeholders must come together.

You have at least five years of hands-on experience with the design, construction and commissioning of electrical installations at major process, energy or industrial facilities operating under the ATEX Directive. You are accustomed to taking technical solutions from concept through to safe, reliable and operational installations, with practical experience across the entire project lifecycle – not just the design phase.

Your background may come from industries such as Power-to-X, refineries, biogas, oil and gas, process manufacturing or other large-scale energy and process facilities. Your specific industry background is less important than your experience delivering projects of a comparable size and technical complexity to the Danish Hydrogen Backbone.

In addition, we expect you:

• 
have extensive experience with electrical installations in ATEX environments

• 
have a solid understanding of Danish legislation, industry standards and regulatory requirements relevant to electrical installations

• 
have experience performing technical reviews and preparing engineering documentation within complex EPC or EPCM projects

• 
work in a structured and systematic manner and are comfortable taking technical ownership

• 
communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing

• 
are eligible to obtain Danish security clearance

• 
hold a valid Category B driving licence

Danish does not need to be your native language. However, we expect you to have previous professional experience working in Denmark and to be familiar with the Danish regulatory framework and industry standards applicable to major technical facilities.

Join one of Denmark's leading engineering teams

You will become part of the Project Engineering department in Gas Transmission – a multidisciplinary engineering team comprising specialists in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering and Instrumentation.

You will join a collaborative and highly technical environment where knowledge sharing, professional sparring and engineering excellence are integral to the way we work. At Energinet, you will have the opportunity to continuously develop your expertise through technically complex projects, internal specialist networks and close collaboration with some of the industry's most experienced engineers.

The position is based in either Ballerup or Egtved. During the current phase of the project, you should expect to spend one to two days per week at the project office in Ballerup, as well as undertaking occasional international travel to collaborate with project partners.

Ready to help shape the future of energy infrastructure?

At Energinet, you will become part of an organisation with a long-term perspective, where the solutions you help develop will play a vital role in Denmark's energy system for decades to come.

If you are motivated by technically complex projects, engineering excellence and the opportunity to contribute to the green transition through the development of critical energy infrastructure, we would love to hear from you.

PeopleLink is managing the recruitment process on behalf of Energinet. If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact us.

At Energinet, we believe that diversity strengthens our organisation, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and therefore encourage you to omit your photo, age, marital status and similar personal information from your application to help minimise unconscious bias throughout the recruitment process.

You can read more about Energinet's diversity policy here.

A fast-growing international service group is strengthening it’s executive leadership team and is now seeking an experienced, business-minded Group CFO to lead the next phase of growth and professionalisation.

The company operates across several European markets within a people- and operations-intensive industry, providing services that directly impact wellbeing, and everyday life. It is a market leader in it’s niche, built on a strong operational foundation and backed by a long-term Private Equity partner. With a proven track record of organic and acquisition-driven expansion, the organisation is now entering a new and exciting growth phase focused on scalability, digitalisation, and operational excellence.

The Role

As Group CFO, you will:

• Lead and further develop a professional, business-oriented finance function covering FP&A, Controlling, and Finance Operations.

• Build a consistent group-wide operating model with strong governance, transparency, and commercial focus.

• Drive financial planning, performance management, and data-driven decision-making.

• Act as a strategic partner to the CEO and owners, balancing long-term vision with hands-on execution.

• Support commercialisation, integration, and digital transformation initiatives across multiple markets.

• Play an active role in shaping a fast-moving, entrepreneurial organisation where speed, pragmatism, and ownership are essential.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced and energetic finance leader with strong analytical and commercial capabilities, ideally coming from international service, retail-style, or multi-site operations.

You thrive in both strategic and operational contexts and enjoy working close to the business — combining structure, execution power, and curiosity.

Key requirements:

• Minimum 10 years of progressive finance experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (CFO/Finance Director).

• Experience from international, multi-entity organisations in growth or transformation environments.

• Proven ability to lead teams across geographies and create alignment between finance, operations, and commercial functions.

• Strong understanding of ERP, consolidation, and BI/reporting systems, with a genuine interest in digitalisation and automation.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Master’s-level degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration.

• Hands-on and visible leadership style – comfortable working close to the details and leading by example in a growing business.

Personal Characteristics

Energetic, structured, and business-oriented with high integrity and natural authority.

You are proactive, pragmatic, and unafraid to “get your hands dirty” when needed.

You create clarity in complexity, inspire collaboration, and balance strategic thinking with practical execution.

A true team player who communicates transparently, builds trust, and thrives in a fast-moving growth environment.

jobs.occupation: Mid-level Software Engineer for Circle Gas
jobs.description:
Connectivity, IoT Core, & SIM Lifecycle

On behalf of our customer Circle Gas we are seeking a Mid-level Software Engineer to join their Virtual Device team. This team is the heartbeat of our operation, responsible for the interface between our smart devices and our applications. In this role, you will help build the "nervous system" of their IoT network.

You will work heavily with AWS IoT Core to manage telemetry ingestion and command structures, ensuring their digital twins accurately reflect the physical state of millions of meters. A specific focus of this role will be managing the lifecycle of SIM cards and ensuring robust meter connectivity.

As an Software Engineer, you will be expected to own the delivery of features within your team, write and debug code that affects large parts of our systems, and actively participate in design discussions.

Key Responsibilities

• Core Development: Write, test, and deploy high-quality code (Python & TypeScript) for their virtual device microservices using AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, etc.)

• IoT & Connectivity: Implement and maintain telemetry ingestion pipelines and command/control interfaces using AWS IoT Core

• SIM Lifecycle Management: Build and refine the logic for managing SIM card activation, deactivation, and status monitoring to ensure uninterrupted meter connectivity

• System Reliability: Ensure the production readiness of your code; monitor telemetry flows and debug connectivity issues across the fleet

• Collaboration: Work closely with firmware engineers and the data team to understand data payloads and ensure seamless integration

• Team Growth: Actively contribute to the Circle Tech culture, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge with the team

• Infrastructure as Code: Utilize Terraform to manage and deploy infrastructure, ensuring repeatable and secure environments

Qualifications

• Experience: Proven experience in software engineering (typically aligned with L4 expectations: delivering features independently and understanding the broader system)

• Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript

• Cloud Native: Hands-on experience with AWS Serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway) and EventDriven Design

• IoT Knowledge: Experience with AWS IoT Core or similar MQTT-based telemetry systems is highly desirable

• Mindset: You thrive in a maturing "scale-up" environment—you are comfortable with some ambiguity and eager to help establish better processes

About Circle Gas

Circle Gas is a revolutionary company focused on transforming the lives of people in sub-Saharan Africa and beyond.

We are scaling rapidly to support 2 million households (10 million people), providing clean, safe, and affordable cooking fuel. Data is the lifeblood of our operation—from billing 10 million customers to optimizing logistics in remote areas.

Your key areas of responsibility:

• Delivery of projects on time and within budget

• Reduction in downtime and improvement in equipment reliability

Examples of tasks could include:

Do you know what separates a backlog a team can build from and a backlog a team has to decode? We are looking for an experienced Product Owner who wants backlog craftsmanship to be the centre of the job — across three software teams building the platforms that run Eurowind's energy parks and energy trading.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to join our IT Software department. Based at our head office in Hobro, Denmark, you will have your home base in our Automation & Masterdata team — and you will be the Product Owner who owns the backlog itself across all three of our software teams.

The backlog is yours, across three teams

IT Software runs three development teams — Trading & Monitoring, Automation & Masterdata, and Explore & Interact — with more than 15 engineers between them. We have deliberately split product ownership across three people with different centres of gravity rather than one generalist per team. One of your two Product Owner colleagues also holds the Scrum Master role and owns how we work: ceremonies, flow and continuous improvement. The other also holds project management and owns delivery towards the business: timelines, dependencies and stakeholder commitments. You will own the third piece — the backlog itself.

Your day-to-day home is the Automation & Masterdata team, where six developers and a team lead build the automation, data and masterdata foundation the rest of the business relies on. But because a backlog standard is only worth something if it is the same everywhere, your work will touch stories in all three teams.

Work reaches you from two directions. Larger projects and initiatives come in through our IT Portfolio Manager, who owns intake and demand at portfolio level, so a good share of what lands in the backlog arrives already framed and prioritised at a high level. The rest comes straight from the business, often as a half-formed idea from someone who knows their own domain far better than they know software. Turning both kinds into work a team can pick up is where you make the difference.

• Own the backlog as the single source of truth — capture, structure and maintain epics, stories and bugs so the teams always know what is next and why

• Refine feature requests into clear, testable items with acceptance criteria that hold up when development starts

• Set and maintain a shared standard for how work is written across the three teams, so a story reads the same whether it originates in Trading, Automation or Explore

• Make priority and scope calls together with your two Product Owner colleagues, the team leads and our solution architect

• Partner with our IT Portfolio Manager on larger projects and initiatives, and handle direct requests from the business for everything else

• Work with stakeholders across Operations, Trading, Commercial, BI and GIS to turn business needs into work the teams can act on

• Support release readiness — approve completed items and help stakeholders understand what is coming

• Keep Jira and Confluence trustworthy, so progress, dependencies and blockers are visible without anyone having to ask

• Help shape how we use AI in product work — we are currently building Claude skills that support user story intake and refinement, and this role has a real say in how far we take that

You will not be doing this in isolation. The three of you meet weekly with the team leads and our architect, and you will have a direct line to the developers whose week your backlog shapes.

Clear boundaries, real ownership

We lead with direction and mandate rather than detailed instruction. You will get the expectations and the boundaries agreed up front, and from there you decide how the work gets done. That only works if the roles around you are clear — which is why we have written down and agreed what the Manager, Product Owner, Scrum Master, Solution Architect and Team Lead each own, so you know where your decisions start and where they hand over.

• Real mandate over the backlog across three teams, and genuine influence on how the department works

• Two Product Owner colleagues, a Scrum Master, a solution architect and three team leads to spar with — this is not a role where you are the only one thinking about product

• A department leaning into AI in practice rather than in theory — we use it daily and are actively building Claude skills for user story intake and refinement, with the ambition of taking the mechanical part of backlog work off your plate so you can spend your time on the judgement calls

• A department in the middle of building its platforms, so what you shape now will still be visible in a few years

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home

• Lunch scheme, coffee, tea and fruit, discount agreements and a bonus scheme

• An international environment with colleagues in 16 countries, where English is a natural part of everyday work

You will report to Daniel Otkjær, Senior Manager, Software Development, and become part of the leadership group in IT Software.

Required competencies and skills

This is a senior position. Because the standard you set reaches every story in three teams, we are looking for someone who has done product ownership before and knows what a well-written backlog is worth on a busy week. We put weight on the following:

• Several years of experience as a Product Owner in a software environment, ideally across more than one team or product

• Demonstrated experience with backlog management, refinement and writing acceptance criteria that survive contact with development

• Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools; Confluence is an advantage

• Openness to working with AI as part of the job is a clear advantage, and hands-on experience using it for intake, refinement, documentation or stakeholder work is even better

• The ability to hold a shared standard across teams through clarity and collaboration rather than formal authority

• Comfortable moving between audiences — you can talk to a trader, an operations specialist and a developer on the same day and meet each of them where they are

• Structured in your approach, and at ease when priorities shift at short notice, which they will in a company growing in several directions at once

• Fluent in English in speech and writing; Danish is an advantage

• Knowledge of energy trading or the renewable energy sector is a plus, but something you can learn with us

A formal certification such as CSPO or SAFe Product Owner is a plus, but not a requirement — what matters most is what you have actually run.

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record. A security clearance may become relevant later in the employment, but it is not required in order to apply.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.

Read more about Eurowind Energy A/S on our website (eurowindenergy.com) or LinkedIn.

Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV as soon as possible.

Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Daniel Otkjær, Senior Manager, Software Development, at dot@ewe.dk.

Application deadline: Rolling – we invite candidates for interviews as applications come in.

Place of work: Hobro, Denmark

Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion

• 
Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.

• 
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.

Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.

Data Platform & Infrastructure

Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.

• 
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.

Data Quality & Governance

Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.

Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.

Collaboration & Stakeholders

• 
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.

• 
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.

About You

• 
You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.

• 
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.

• 
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.

• 
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.

• 
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.

Qualifications

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.

• 
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.

• 
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).

• 
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).

• 
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).

• 
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.

• 
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

• 
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience with data observability tooling.

• 
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).

• 
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.

• 
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).

• 
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. jobs.description:
Product Owner (Manager Role) for global backup and recovery service

For one of our clients, a large Danish company within the Life science & Pharma industry, we are seeking an experienced Product Owner for backup and recovery with leadership experience. You will take part in shape the future of enterprise backup technology and safeguard the data that enables life-changing treatments to reach millions of patients.

Backup, and recovery

As Product Owner, you’ll lead and own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for the organization’s backup technology. • Strong technical background in backup and recovery technologies, with solid understanding of RPO/RTO, retention schemes, backup architecture, snapshots, replication and restore workflows

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and build consensus across diverse teams

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Experience working within regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX) in enterprise IT environments is a plus.

Do you thrive in a role where you are close to the pulse of the business and work directly with executive management? Your role and responsibilities

As an Executive Assistant, you will occupy a key role as the central focal point, setting the direction for management's administration and creating structure. In this position, execution and discretion are priority areas and are seen as a crucial discipline where high quality is paramount. • Planning and organizing meetings, gathering input, and managing logistics

• A minimum of 5–10 years of documented, successful experience as a PA/EA supporting C-level management

• A relevant educational background, such as a BA in Business Administration, or equivalent solid experience

• Excellent communication skills, fluent proficiency in English (written and spoken), and strong IT and MS Office capabilities

• Experience navigating complex global travel logistics and an understanding of cross-cultural differences

• A proactive, highly service-minded, and independent approach with a strong "can-do" attitude

Why you should join Norican?

You will be close to the heart of the business while becoming part of a professional, informal, and down-to-earth culture, where people work closely together, trust each other, and focus on making things happen. Professionally, you will benefit from a direct reporting line to the CEO and hold a central position that ensures the executive team’s continuous efficiency both locally and globally.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

Ready to learn more and ready to apply?

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. We will process your application confidentially, and it will only be shared with your prior consent. If you have any further questions about the position, feel free to contact our Recruitment Consultant on this role Mille Maegaard-Fast at +45 92 92 08 53.

Working closely with business stakeholders, IT colleagues, vendors, and partners, you will drive improvements, translate business needs into solutions, and help shape the future direction of our ERP landscape.
